contexts.text: The spirit of Jacob... revived () = new life in natural good.
When they die and revive as to the spirit, which is usually on the third day...
The Angels said, This is for the sake of the end that the Christian Church, which is founded upon the Word, and is now at its end, may revive again, and draw breath through Heaven from the Lord.
The breath from which they revived () = spiritual life, which is life according to the truths of the Word. AE 666:3.
11. The Word, through which the Church would revive. Signified.
